project_type: pnpm monorepo, TypeScript; packages/curse-engine (zero-UI engine), apps/grimmod (Next.js 16 + Tailwind 4 reference app), apps/deadbeat (placeholder package.json + README only)
build_system: pnpm workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml: packages/*, apps/*). New workspace dirs under packs/ are NOT in the workspace unless pnpm-workspace.yaml is edited; pnpm-lock.yaml must stay in sync so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` passes.
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @curseengine/deadbeat build
verification_instructions: From a clean state (rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules) run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm test; pnpm typecheck. Baseline: engine 74 + grimmod 44 = 118 tests green. Finally `git diff --stat e07fdb1 -- packages/curse-engine` must be empty.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/grammar.md generated from .kiro/specs/curse-engine/design.md (do not edit; engine untouched anyway). Root script curse:check runs engine properties + grimmod sim:fixtures; .kiro/hooks/resim-on-curse-save.json matcher is \.curse$|... so packs/**/*.curse trigger it (optionally extend curse:check/sim script for deadbeat and pack; hook files may be edited).
setup_instructions: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (deps already installed in sandbox; baseline verified green). After adding apps/deadbeat dependencies, run `pnpm install` once to update pnpm-lock.yaml, commit lockfile, then confirm --frozen-lockfile passes. Prefer reusing exact dependency versions from apps/grimmod/package.json.
environment_constraints: No pushing/PRs (orchestrator pushes); commit locally on main with existing git identity (Kiro Agent), do not modify git config. No deploys, DB, external services or real email: the mail adapter writes to an in-memory outbox only. packages/curse-engine MUST NOT be modified at all.
contribution_requirements: en-GB in prose; no em dashes in written content; keep inviolables (.kiro/steering/inviolables.md): no exfiltration, simulator never executes side effects, every action reversible. Keep ratified semantics (docs/grammar.md Executor semantics).
key_patterns: GrimMod: src/lib/{host,adapter,chat-state,grimoire,fixtures,graph,http}.ts, singleton host via globalThis (getHost/resetHost/refreshFixtures), fixtures with stable ids + REFERENCE_NOW, GrimoireRepository wrapping engine AuditLog, grimoire.reverse(entryId, inverse, now) appends a reversal entry, API routes in app/api/{curses,curses/[id]/graph,curses/[id]/simulate,events,fixtures,grimoire,grimoire/[id]/undo,health,reset}/route.ts, components in src/components/{GrimMod,Grimoire,RuleGraph,Simulator}.tsx. Engine: executor handles type 'tick' events with .interval for `every` curses (durationMs match), fields bag, `email <template> to <field>` calls capability email({curse,eventId,template,to}); tick events not stored in history; executor itself dedupes nothing, host must. GrimMod's viewOf marks email as non-reversible; Deadbeat must make email reversible via an inverse that marks the outbox entry retracted.
directory_structure: apps/ packages/ docs/ .kiro/ (specs, steering, hooks); new: packs/standup/
